what_it_does: Single RS frame -> 3D translational + angular velocity of a patterned sphere; correspondence-free two-stage optimisation.
what_it_does_not_do: Object (sphere) motion, not camera; designed pattern.
how_we_differ: Object-level; we estimate camera motion.

title: Rectifying Rolling Shutter Video from Hand-Held Devices
authors: Per-Erik Forssén, Erik Ringaby
what_it_does: Models RS distortion as 3D camera motion; continuous curve with knots at last row of each frame; NLS over KLT tracks; synthetic RS dataset.
how_we_differ: Image-based (no gyro) video rectification precedent.

title: Digital Video Stabilization and Rolling Shutter Correction using Gyroscopes
authors: Alexandre Karpenko, David Jacobs, Jongmin Baek, Marc Levoy
verified: VERIFIED (Wayback snapshot of project page + tech report PDF)
what_it_does: Gyro-only, rotation-only camera model; auto calibration of gyro drift + delay, focal length and RS speed from one video + gyro capture; synthetic smooth GLOBAL-shutter camera (t_s=0) with Gaussian-smoothed rotations; per-row warp as mesh with ~10 vertical subdivisions on GPU; crop; real-time on phone.
what_it_does_not_do: Ignores translation explicitly ('difficult to measure accurately using IMUs'); no depth; no 3D.
code: Y https://github.com/alexgo1/Video-Stabilization (GPL-3.0; linked as 'Source Code' from project page)
how_we_differ: Our EXP1 oracle is this idea with GT; our method replaces the gyro with image-predicted (w,v) and also handles translation.

title: Efficient Video Rectification and Stabilisation for Cell-Phones
authors: Erik Ringaby, Per-Erik Forssén
venue: IJCV vol 96 pp 335-352 (2012; published online 10 June 2011) (Springer page)
what_it_does: Rectifies + stabilises cell-phone RS video by modelling 3D camera rotation as a continuous curve fitted to KLT tracks.
how_we_differ: Rotation-only; we add translation and 3D outputs.

title: A Non-Linear Filter for Gyroscope-Based Video Stabilization
authors: Steven Bell, Alejandro Troccoli, Kari Pulli
what_it_does: Real-time in-pipeline gyro stabilisation + RS correction; tracks angular velocity; small-latency window.
how_we_differ: Same as Karpenko.

title: Fused Video Stabilization on the Pixel 2 and Pixel 2 XL (blog)
authors: Chia-Kai Liang, Fuhao Shi
what_it_does: Phone EIS+OIS: gyro rotation + measured lens motion (OIS x/y, focus z); virtual camera path; frame split into a mesh, multiple transforms per frame to correct RS.
what_it_does_not_do: No translation handling described; product description, no paper.
how_we_differ: Explains what stabilised phone footage contains (see md).

title: Deep Online Fused Video Stabilization
authors: Zhenmei Shi, Fuhao Shi, Wei-Sheng Lai, Chia-Kai Liang, Yingyu Liang
what_it_does: LSTM predicts virtual camera pose from gyro + OIS + optical flow; warps sensor-based real motion toward it, correcting RS without wobble; gyro/OIS dataset.
how_we_differ: Stabilisation; relevant to what phone footage looks like.

title: DeepOIS: Gyroscope-Guided Deep Optical Image Stabilizer Compensation
authors: Haipeng Li, Shuaicheng Liu, Jue Wang
venue: IEEE TCSVT vol 32 no 5, May 2022 (arXiv journal-ref)
what_it_does: CNN compensates OIS motion so gyro alone can align OIS frames; 'Fundamental Mixtures' RS model gives per-frame rotation arrays as GT guidance.
how_we_differ: Gyro-dependent; we are images-only.

title: Single Image Rolling Shutter Removal with Diffusion Models
authors: Zhanglei Yang, Haipeng Li, Mingbo Hong, Chen-Lin Zhang, Jiajun Li, Shuaicheng Liu
venue: arXiv (no comments; an ojs.aaai.org link appeared in search results but was NOT opened -> AAAI venue UNVERIFIED)
what_it_does: Diffusion-based single-image RS removal; RS-Real dataset whose GS GT is made by gyro-based correction of RS frames.
what_it_does_not_do: Image-to-image; gyro used for dataset GT (inference use not stated on page).
how_we_differ: Shows gyro-unrolled GT pipeline like our EXP1; we output geometry.

title: Gyroscope-aided Relative Pose Estimation for Rolling Shutter Cameras
authors: Chang-Ryeol Lee, Ju Hong Yoon, Min-Gyu Park, Kuk-Jin Yoon
what_it_does: Gyro angular velocity + images -> minimal 5-point RS relative pose solver (Gröbner basis).
how_we_differ: Gyro-privileged; we infer w from images.

title: Inertial-aided Rolling Shutter Relative Pose Estimation
authors: Chang-Ryeol Lee, Kuk-Jin Yoon
what_it_does: Gravity + angular velocity from IMU reduce RS relative pose to 9/11 points; PennCOSYVIO.
how_we_differ: IMU-privileged.
